subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared agent-facing inbound attachment metadata contract for channel plugins, or keep Slack file access limited to placeholders plus media path/type fields?
rationale: The code can expose more Slack fields, but the durable choice affects shared channel context, plugin SDK expectations, docs, and cross-channel behavior rather than one Slack implementation detail.

options.title: Design shared attachment contract
options.body: Add a cross-channel `InboundAttachments`-style shape with provider IDs, names, MIME types, sizes, local paths, and download state while preserving current media fields.

options.title: Keep current placeholder workflow
options.body: Treat visible `fileId` placeholders plus `download-file` as sufficient and close or narrow this issue to docs/tests only.

options.title: Add Slack-only metadata
options.body: Expose Slack file fields directly now, accepting the risk of later migration when other channels need the same shape.

recommendation.title: Design shared attachment contract
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel `InboundAttachments`-style shape with provider IDs, names, MIME types, sizes, local paths, and download state while preserving current media fields.
